Hi and Welcome to the Mechatronics Student Association of RMIT! Mechatronics is an engineering discipline that encompasses robotics, electrical, electronics and mechanical engineering systems. This relatively new multidisciplinary field of engineering allows students to implement and integrate different physics or technologies for the purposes solving complex problems. This student run club is all about creating a community of Mechatronics engineers and enthusiasts, where we can share ideas, knowledge and connections to industry.

The RMIT Medical Radiation Student Association (MRSA) is the official student body representing students enrolled in RMIT’s Bachelor of Medical Radiation program and other healthcare programs. We aim to support, represent, and connect medical radiation students throughout their academic journey and beyond, including graduates across Victoria. For 2026, MRSA enters a new chapter with the motto: "Help each other, grow, and connect." MRSA will deliver a wide range of academic, professional, and social events, including industry networking, peer support initiatives, and social gatherings designed to strengthen student connections. Membership is FREE for 2026 and takes only a few minutes to complete via our registration form. All returning members are required to renew their membership to remain eligible for member-exclusive benefits and discounts. To join or renew, please register using the link provided on our website.
